text: My daughter started training here 3 years ago at 8, and she still loves it!! Owner and coaching staff are all super encouraging. We live an hour away but make the drive twice a week as often as possible. Training here has not only helped her get stronger physically but increased her confidence in general. Anything that makes kids want to challenge themselves to get better and better is worth it!- Lee C.

We had our son’s 10th birthday here. All of the kids had a great time. They set up an obstacle course for the kids. They loved the whole experience. The favorite was the curved wall to run up. That was everyone’s challenge for the night. We will be visiting again for sure.- Jennifer L.

100% recommend Springfield Warrior Sports! We had my sons 5th birthday here and it was painless and SO fun! The staff answered all questions I had, gave reminders for upcoming party, and interacted with the kids during the party. It has been weeks since the party and my son is still talking about it. We will absolutely be back!- Cheyenne M.

We have had several birthday parties here and each time has been wonderful. It’s affordable and does not require a lot of effort on my part. The best part is how much fun the kids have! They never want to leave! The staff were all engaged with the kids and joined in on the nerf battle. I think they were having as much fun as the kids! They made sure we had everything we needed. We also enjoy coming to open gym. It’s the perfect place for kids to burn some energy. We love it here and we highly recommend it!- Adrienne E.

We have been going to the gym for classes for a while and my kids really enjoy it. I see huge improvements in their strength and flexibility. We recently did a birthday party for my 8 year old and it was amazing! They had staff members engaged with the kids the entire time ensuring safety and that everyone was having fun. Definitely recommend for parties, and their flexible schedule for classes and open gym make it easy to fit in.- Liz S.
Great place to have a birthday party. The laser tag option was really cool. My boys had a blast. Plus my son loves their summer camp program & he looks forward to it every summer!- Susan K.

Staff was friendly, knowledgeable, and quick to help out. They were great with assisting my son(who can be a bit difficult at times). We signed up for the Beginner classes today and my son LOVED his first day!- Kevin P.
My kids love the classes here! The instructors are all very kind and fun. It is such a great way for our kids to get exercise and learn new body skills.- Nick P.

It was too hot for my bf and I to let the kids play outside. We had already been to the overcrowded pool. So we took the kids here to run around and burn off energy inside while we got a second workout in ourselves. Amazing staff, great atmosphere, 10/5 would recommend!- Courtney C.

After losing some weight on my own, I hit a wall. Warrior Sports changed the game for me. My coach built a program just for me and held me accountable in a way that made me stronger, leaner, and more confident—not just physically, but mentally.- Client

Over a year, I lost over 50 pounds, gained mobility and confidence, and competed in multiple obstacle races. Warrior Sports is family-friendly, fun, and motivating. My trainer, Jacob, made workouts fast, personal, and sustainable.— Michael B.

Jonny has coached our son for over three years. He’s a mentor, a role model, and a true confidence builder. His dedication helped our son compete at the WNL World Championships two years in a row.— Will and Koren Wilson
My son’s personal training at Warrior Sports has helped him with body image, goal setting, and self-confidence. It’s been so rewarding to watch him grow.— Susie K.
